## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-5001. The feature-backfill pods are stuck pending because the AWS account has reached its vCPU limit (256 vCPU limit with a new 96 vCPU request). The cluster-autoscaler attempted to scale up nodes but failed with "VcpuLimitExceeded" errors. The fix is for the cloud platform team to request a vCPU limit increase from AWS.
